relations.statement: Imported assumption: for a concatenated code family under the cited noise model, with locality and overhead hypotheses, there exists a threshold p_th>0 such that physical error rate p<p_th allows arbitrarily accurate computation with polylogarithmic overhead. Cited, not re-proved.
relations.hypotheses: Each cited theorem's own noise model, locality and overhead hypotheses (Shor 1996; Aharonov and Ben-Or 1997; Kitaev 1997; Knill, Laflamme and Zurek 1998; Aliferis, Gottesman and Preskill 2006). Exact constants not reproduced.

lemmas.statement: Imported threshold hypothesis as an explicit Prop-valued assumption, not proved: ThresholdAssumption noise_model -> exists p_th > 0, forall p < p_th, logical error vanishes under concatenation.
lemmas.lean_skeleton:
axiom ThresholdAssumption : Prop
theorem threshold_import (h : ThresholdAssumption) : ThresholdAssumption := h

near_misses.claim: A threshold exists for arbitrary noise, including strongly correlated or non-local noise, with no hypotheses.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Each theorem requires its stated noise model (e.g. independent or sufficiently local, weakly correlated) and locality hypotheses.

near_misses.claim: All cited theorems share one threshold constant.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Constants differ by theorem, code and noise model; none are reproduced here.

open_obligations: No existing declarations were provided in @SRC or @KNOWN+, so nothing is cited as existing.
Exact threshold constants for each theorem are not reproduced.
Precise noise model formalization for each theorem is not formalized.
The finite recurrence in QCV-Q2 is checked elsewhere and not re-derived here.
